Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: The plan includes an inventory of district facilities with details on building sizes, ancillary spaces, and phased capacity expansions (Ch1 pp.4-11). It provides a condition assessment with modernization plans and prioritization but lacks multiple data sources or detailed system monitoring.

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: The plan provides comprehensive enrollment projections over a 10+ year horizon with detailed grade-level data and development impacts (Ch2-3 pp.15-21). It links capacity needs to phased facility expansions and discusses developer fees and mitigation strategies.

Educational Alignment.justification: The plan references educational programs such as CTE expansions and ancillary spaces but only at a basic level without detailed educational specifications or strong connections between facilities and instructional goals (Ch1 pp.9-11, Ch3 p.24).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: There is no mention or analysis of outdoor spaces, greening, shade, or outdoor learning in the plan content provided.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: The plan acknowledges site infrastructure needs and proximity to hazards but does not provide a detailed climate risk assessment or resilience strategies related to climate impacts (Ch1 p.4).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: No mention of energy efficiency, electrification, decarbonization, or energy resilience strategies is found in the plan content.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: The plan includes detailed cost estimates for phased projects with contingency and soft costs, and discusses funding sources such as developer fees and state programs (Ch1-2 pp.10-14, Ch3 p.24). It outlines prioritization but lacks a comprehensive long-term financial sustainability analysis.
